summary: Solid three-tier test suite (unit/CLI/end-to-end via act) with excellent boundary condition testing and comprehensive error scenarios. Covers all stated requirements including TDD, fixtures, Pester, workflow validation, and act integration. Main concerns: module implementation (SecretRotationValidator.psm1) not provided so tests cannot be fully verified; some design issues (external powershell-yaml dependency, pwsh subprocess spawning in unit tests, hard-coded expected output strings in Run-ActTests create brittleness). Missing some edge cases like special characters in secret names, timezone handling, and stress testing with many secrets. Would catch most regressions but depends on unseen module correctness.
